# equinix_fabric_internet_access_service (Data Source)

Fabric V4 API compatible data resource that allows users to fetch an Equinix Internet Access (EIA) service by UUID.

Additional Documentation:
* API: https://docs.equinix.com/api-catalog/fabricv4/#tag/Internet-Access



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `internet_access_service_id` (String) The UUID of the Internet Access service this data source should retrieve

### Read-Only

- `account` (Attributes) Account associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))
- `bandwidth` (Number) Bandwidth of the service
- `bandwidth_commit` (Number) Minimum bandwidth commit for the burst billing variant of the service
- `billing` (Attributes) Billing details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--billing))
- `change` (Attributes) Current state of the latest change on the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change))
- `change_log` (Attributes) Audit log of changes to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--change_log))
- `href` (String) Equinix auto generated URI to the Internet Access service
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the resource
- `locations` (Attributes List) Locations associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))
- `name` (String) Name of the Internet Access service
- `order` (Attributes) Order details of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--order))
- `project` (Attributes) Project associated with the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--project))
- `routing_protocol` (Attributes) Routing protocol configuration of the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol))
- `state` (String) Provisioning state of the service. One of: PROVISIONING, PROVISIONED, FAILED, DEPROVISIONING, DEPROVISIONED
- `type` (String) Type of the Internet Access service. One of: SINGLE_IA, DUAL_IA
- `use_case` (String) Use case of the service. One of: MAIN, MANAGEMENT_ACCESS
- `uuid` (String) Equinix-assigned unique identifier for the Internet Access service

Read-Only:

- `account_number` (String) Account number
- `href` (String) URI to the account

- `updated_date_time` (String) Last update time of the service

Read-Only:

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the order
- `order_id` (String) Order identification
- `order_number` (String) Order reference number
- `purchase_order_number` (String) Purchase order number
- `term_length` (Number) Term length in months

### Nested Schema for `project`

Read-Only:

<a id="nestedatt--routing_protocol"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_protocol`

Read-Only:

- `connections` (Attributes List) Fabric connections attached to the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--connections))
- `customer_routes` (Attributes List) Customer routes announced through the service (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--customer_routes))
- `type` (String) Routing protocol type. One of: BGP, DIRECT, STATIC

<a id="nestedatt--routing_protocol--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_protocol.connections`

Read-Only:

- `href` (String) URI to the connection

- `peering_ipv6` (Attributes) IPv6 peering details of the connection (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routing_protocol--connections--peering_ipv6))

<a id="nestedatt--routing_protocol--connections--peering_ipv4"></a>
### Nested Schema for `routing_protocol.connections.peering_ipv4`

Read-Only:

- `customer_peer_ip` (String) Peering IP address on the customer side
- `customer_vrrp_ip` (String) VRRP IP address on the customer side
- `equinix_peer_ip` (String) Peering IP address on the Equinix side
- `equinix_vrrp_ip` (String) VRRP IP address on the Equinix side
- `prefix` (String) IPv4 prefix for the peering connection
- `prefix_length` (Number) Determines the size of the subnet
